wants.topic: Micro-history of daily cultural life & nostalgia (e.g., 100-year-old weddings, old Diwali traditions)
wants.evidence: Unknown Itihaas achieved 19.16x and 7.24x vsNormal on '100 साल पहले दिवाली' and 'दादा-दादी के जमाने में ऐसी होती थी शादी' (5.6M+ and 2.8M+ views).

wants.topic: Pre-historic human origins & societal shifts in Hindi (Aadimanav discovery of farming, salt, caste origins)
wants.evidence: Aakash Tatawat got 298x vsNormal (1.09M views) on Human Evolution and 133x on Caste origin; History Industry got 12.1x vsNormal (12.3M views) on Aadimanav farming.

wants.topic: Architectural secrets & hidden spaces of iconic monuments (Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Pyramids)
wants.evidence: The Unseen Bharat hit 57.7x vsNormal on Red Fort secrets; Unknown Itihaas hit 6.01x vsNormal (5.1M views) on Taj Mahal; History Industry got 7x vsNormal on Pyramids.

wants.topic: Macro 'Entire History' mega-documentaries on major empires & conquests (Alexander, Roman Empire, Complete India)
wants.evidence: The Unseen Bharat scored 72.8x vsNormal on 'Complete History of India'; Flashback Frenzy's top videos are Entire History of Alexander (1.9M views) and Roman Empire (1.3M views).

gaps: Ground-level everyday human history of 18th-20th century India (how normal citizens lived, celebrated, and traveled beyond political rulers).
Nuanced social history (objective, non-sensational origins of Indian social structures, trade routes, and dietary habits like discovery of salt/spices).
Detailed engineering and architectural breakdowns of ancient Indian temples and fort systems in Hindi.
saturated: Generic British oppression / colonial rule overviews without a specific narrative hook.
Obscure foreign civilizations lacking Indian cultural hook or human element (e.g., Byzantine Empire, Maya Civilization).
Over-broad scientific origin videos (e.g., Origin of Life on Earth) misaligned with human history documentary audiences.
Repetitive, high-level summaries of medieval massacres (e.g., Timur's atrocities) without new archival visuals or fresh perspective.
